questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Digital GPIO input and output”?
options: Do not assume Arduino UNO pin mappings apply to a different MCU family.
INPUT_PULLUP enables an internal pull-up for the idle input.

questions.answer: INPUT_PULLUP enables an internal pull-up for the idle input.
questions.explanation:
INPUT_PULLUP enables an internal pull-up for the idle input.
Why: pinMode configures direction; digitalRead and digitalWrite handle logic levels. Inputs must not float: use a suitable pull-up/down and account for button bounce.
